rationale: No supported optimization is safe to apply. All three jobs already have explicit custom timeouts (test: 15, napi-versions: 10, package-tests: 10 minutes), so P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is already satisfied; tightening them risks false timeouts on slow/cold Emscripten builds without per-job duration history, and the measured experiment (batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) added a timeout to a job that had none, which is not the case here. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated: the matrix spans distinct WASM targets and modes where every outcome is required for full failure diagnostics, and no policy makes remaining matrix results dispensable after a failure, so keep fail-fast: false. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE cannot be verified because dependency installation occurs inside the opaque local setup-target-ci action, so an equivalent cache may already exist; adding cache speculatively risks redundancy and unrelated changes. No schedule triggers exist, so P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE do not apply. Build/test coverage is preserved as-is.
